~INTRODUCTION~

Hello! I am Finnbro, co-owner and founder of the Nathan Classic Minecraft server. I am new to the Voat community but I have actively used Reddit for many years and this appears to be a fundamentally similar website and community. We are looking to recruit players who would be interested in a server with many different available game-modes and maps along with a relaxed, mature and laid-back community. I have mainly recruited players for this server using Reddit, so prospective players from this site will likely have a lot in common with some of our prominent, active members on the server. If you have any questions about the server that this post does not cover, you can contact me on here (or via Reddit, my username is also Finnbro there). I hope this server is appealing to some of you, and if we have grasped your attention please check out some of our more in-depth information below.

~SERVER INFORMATION~

Server Name: Nathan Classic

Server Hosting Location: Virginia (USA)

Server IP: mc.nathanclassic.com

Alternate IP: mc.nathanit.com

Server Subreddit: http://www.reddit.com/r/NathanClassic/

TeamSpeak: ts.nathanclassic.com:9129 (You will need to request the password once you become a member.)

FAQ/Player Guide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i2LUCHHAJcw-HOpHkSLNNzEd5syyxRP_AxTkGjM4guQ

Dynmap: http://mc.nathanclassic.com:8123

Steam Group: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/nathanclassic

Introductory Video: https://youtu.be/Z3owqN4jsvQ?t=1s

Screenshots: http://imgur.com/a/1bhK5

Version: Spigot 1.8 (Latest)

Player Capacity: 20

Available Gamemodes: Creative, Survival, Minigames, Adventure(WIP)

Warps: /warp hub, creative, flat, survival, anarchy, parkour, minigames, adventure, factions, hardcore

~GET TO KNOW NATHAN CLASSIC~

My favorite thing about this server is the community. We have an active and community-involved staff, players of all ages from all around the globe and a laid-back, mature atmosphere that is welcoming to new players looking for a server to call home. A majority of our staff is made up of players from ages 20-40+, but we have players of all ages. Our rules dictate you must act with maturity and without drama, and we hold all players on the server to that standard. No exceptions.

The reason the server is called Nathan Classic is because our Creative map is taken from a now defunct server, NathanIT. NathanIT was an Australia-based Creative server that was online for many years and it was hosted by Nathan Brand who unfortunately passed away in early 2014. Both me and another former member of NathanIT, Vuongot, took it upon ourselves to bring back the spirit of NathanIT in a new server. And so, Nathan Classic was born.

Our main game modes are Freebuild Creative, Survival with some plugins and Minigames. When you first log into our server you'll be greeted by our hub that has a wealth of information about the server. The hub has sign portals that will take you to whichever world you are wanting to go to.

Our Creative gamemode has both terrain and flat maps available, we have multiple different kinds of grief protection so your builds are guaranteed to be safe, and you can obtain WorldEdit with rankups! Members who first join will be somewhat limited in the items that they can utilize in Creative in efforts to help prevent griefing.

Our Survival gamemode has a few plugins to improve the experience like McMMO, LWC, and more. There are lots of towns, shops and various other things to see all over the survival map so go out there and explore! We also have a separate PVP enabled survival map at /warp pvp. We allow players to build anywhere they like on these maps, there are no borders or build limitations as long as you don't build directly on or next to someone else's build without their permission!

The server is hosted in Virginia so players in or near the US will experience the least amount of lag, if any. We have had a large volume of players come and go on Nathan Classic but we do have a solid playerbase with active, mature and helpful people, both staff and non-staff. We're looking to expand the community so if you're looking for a medium-sized server with a tight community, this is the right place for you! The players on the server are mostly made up of my real life friends, redditors I have recruited and players from NathanIT, and we would love to find more cool people who are into playing MP Minecraft peacefully and without drama!

If you are interested in being a part of Nathan Classic, then please read our rules and click some of the links above to find more information about us! Thank you for taking the time to read our post and I guarantee you will enjoy your time on Nathan Classic if you like to creative build, play survival or just be a part of a fun community!

~SERVER RULES~

Absolutely no griefing!

No hacking, OP Items or abusing exploits!

No asking for rank!

No racism, sexism, or bigotry!

Treat others how you want to be treated!

If you choose to build with others, accept what they build.

No spamming or flooding chat!

Please try to use English in the main chat.

If there is a dispute among players, consult a staff member.

No drama, act with maturity.

Listen to staff members!

No advertising unless approved by staff!
